messages.subject: Parsed labels in facet_grid
parts:
Hi,

I try to do a facet plot and want to rename the labels of the
facets. I tried to follow the describtion at
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/facet_grid.html
but I can'T get it work properly. In my case it is a mix of normal
text (with space) and math expression such as m^2. How can that be achieved?

I modify my variable labels with:
df$var <- factor(df$var, labels = c("W A [m^2]", "WUA [m^2]", "HHS"))

and try to plot the new labels with:
facet_grid(..., labeller = label_parsed)

Any suggestions to solve that?

Thanks,

Johannes
